criteria.description: 5+ years production experience with Python backend frameworks (FastAPI or Django)
criteria.how_to_verify: Resume lists Python backend roles with explicit mention of FastAPI or Django and total years >=5, or shows project timelines indicating 5+ years in production

criteria.description: Hands‑on experience with AWS serverless services (Lambda, SQS, S3)
criteria.how_to_verify: Resume includes AWS Lambda, SQS, S3 usage in project descriptions or certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Developer) with concrete responsibilities

criteria.description: Practical experience building with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and Retrieval‑Augmented Generation pipelines
criteria.how_to_verify: Resume mentions integration of OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar LLM APIs, prompt design work, and RAG implementations (e.g., vector stores, document retrieval)

criteria.description: Proficiency with either MongoDB Atlas or PostgreSQL for data storage
criteria.how_to_verify: Resume lists MongoDB Atlas or PostgreSQL as primary data store in backend projects, including schema design or performance tuning

criteria.description: Demonstrated unit testing practice for backend code (e.g., pytest, unittest)
criteria.how_to_verify: Resume cites unit testing frameworks, test coverage metrics, or CI test results; links to GitHub repos showing test suites

criteria.description: Strong written and verbal communication demonstrated through documentation, code reviews, or stakeholder interaction
criteria.how_to_verify: Resume includes experience writing technical docs, leading code reviews, presenting to cross‑functional teams, or mentions of communication‑focused roles

criteria.description: Experience containerizing applications with Docker and orchestrating with Kubernetes or similar
criteria.how_to_verify: Resume lists Docker images, Dockerfiles, Kubernetes manifests, or related deployment responsibilities

criteria.description: Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, etc.)
criteria.how_to_verify: Resume mentions setting up or maintaining CI/CD pipelines, automation scripts, or related tooling
